about:
I'm an Android Developer with a background in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (class of 2022). Since March 2024, I've been building the Android side of a live-stream auction and e-commerce app. My work covers live streaming with AWS IVS and WebRTC, real-time messaging over WebSocket, payment flows, and app performance.

In my free time, I build and publish apps with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Kotlin Multiplatform. I also ship developer tools, such as the SmartCodeSorter IntelliJ plugin.

**10+** Projects Built  ·  **3+** Years Experience  ·  **2** Platforms
